colors.name: void
colors.role: the deep cosmic black — page base, the space the nebula floats in (≈19:1 under particle text)

colors.name: void-rise
colors.role: the void lifting toward the nebula's core — the radial ground behind the hero, a hair lighter than void

colors.name: particle-hi
colors.role: the brightest particle — the white-violet star core; primary text and the nebula's hot spark (16.8:1 on void)

colors.name: particle-violet
colors.role: the mid-stratum particle — the violet drift; secondary display and the beat's steady pulse (5.2:1 on void at large size, used for display/labels only)

colors.name: magenta
colors.role: the hero accent and the nebula's hot rim — focus ring, the on-beat flash, track index numerals, the kick-drum color (5.0:1 on void — large/display and labels only, never small body)

colors.name: dust
colors.role: secondary text — particle-hi at ~55% over void (6.6:1); captions, Korean glosses, track durations

colors.name: dust-dim
colors.role: tertiary text — dust dimmed further over void (3.4:1 — large text only); hairline meta, ticking readouts

colors.name: hairline
colors.role: decorative only (1.6:1) — divider rules, track rows, the sequencer grid; never functional text

colors.name: ember
colors.role: the warm track tint — track 02's color, the second hue of the per-track nebula palette (4.7:1 — large/display only)

colors.name: aqua
colors.role: the cool track tint — track 04's color, the fourth hue of the per-track palette (4.8:1 — large/display only)

fonts.role: technical display — the PULSE wordmark, track numbers, BPM readouts, timestamps, the sequencer's instrument voice
every Korean line and the bilingual body — Korean is first-class body and subheads, never falling through to the default sans stack

texture: A nebula built entirely in code, three layers stacked. (1) The void: a CSS radial-gradient ground — void #05060f at the edges lifting to void-rise #0b0d1f behind the nebula's core, with a soft magenta pool at center-low and a violet pool at upper-right that intensify on the beat (CSS vars --pulse-beat and --pulse-intensity driven by the rAF loop). This is the no-JS view and the canvas understudy. (2) The field: a DPR-capped canvas drawing a few hundred 3D-projected points by hand — each particle has x/y/z, the projection multiplies a perspective matrix (x' = x·f/(f+z), y' = y·f/(f+z)), the camera tilts with pointer parallax (rotX/rotY from pointer offset, lerped and capped), and every point's radius and brightness pulse with the simulated beat envelope. Depth is sorted by z so near points occlude far ones; additive 'lighter' compositing makes overlaps glow. (3) The trail: a low-alpha clear each frame (rgba(5,6,15,0.22)) leaves a faint motion trail — the read of 'energy moving through a medium', not dots on a screen. dpr capped at 2, dt clamped; the whole scene pauses offscreen and on hidden tabs; under reduced motion the field is composed once at a chosen frame and frozen.

motion.name: ease-out-settle
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) — reveals and tracklist hovers: fast in, long settle

motion.name: beat envelope
motion.value: 120 BPM = 0.5s period; envelope = max(0, cos((t mod 0.5)/0.5·π))^1.6 — sharp attack, slow decay; drives particle radius ×(1+0.5·env), brightness, and the magenta rim pool opacity

motion.name: pointer camera lerp
motion.value: rotX += (targetRotX - rotX) · 0.06/frame, capped at ±0.12 rad; targetRotX = (pointerY/height - 0.5) · 0.22 — the nebula leans with you, never snaps

motion.name: particle drift
motion.value: each point orbits its stratum center at 0.04–0.18 rad/s, axial drift 0.2–0.6 u/s; the field is never still between beats

motion.name: scroll-scrub track palette
motion.value: pinned tracklist 280vh; --pulse-track (0→1) lerps the nebula's hue/intensity between five track palettes (violet→magenta→ember→aqua→violet) and the on-beat rim shifts hue with the active track

motion.name: track row reveal
motion.value: tracks fade/translate as they cross the active band, 600ms ease-out-settle; the active track lifts and its index numeral brightens to magenta

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 700ms ease-out-settle, translateY(20px) → 0, 80ms stagger per observer batch

motion.name: title breathe
motion.value: the PULSE wordmark letter-spacing and text-shadow breathe ±2% with the beat envelope under .pulse-js — the wordmark is the heartbeat
